negative_findings.result_summary: Could not retrieve the bylaw index page contents; page is indexed by search engines and linked, so the 403 is most consistent with bot defence, not a dead page. Recorded as unverified, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The whole nbrm.mk domain may need a browser-grade fetcher (real UA, JS, cookies) for the collection pipeline; a naive HTTP crawler would wrongly mark the regulator's core pages dead.

brief: For North Macedonia's A3 regulatory workstream, nbrm.mk is a single, dense, self-contained origin point: the bank publishes its own binding instruments in two parallel registers — supervision decisions (одлуки од областа на супервизијата) for banking and the ЗПУПС regulation set (including a dedicated index of the twelve payments bylaws) for payments — plus a layer of implementing упатства carrying the reporting deadlines, and statutory registers of banks, payment institutions and e-money institutions that reveal licensing decisions in effect. Legal force and exact entry-into-force dates trace to Службен весник на РСМ, whose full archive is subscription-gated, so the practical pipeline is NBRM consolidated PDFs plus Gazette citations, with the year-indexed Соопштенија stream as the fastest early-warning channel. The main structural weaknesses are the pre-adoption stage (no NBRM consultation hub was found; ENER is the likely but unconfirmed proxy) and the absence of any machine-readable feed, which forces HTML/PDF diffing. Collection must use a browser-grade fetcher — a plain fetch of an NBRM regulation index returned HTTP 403, which is a bot-defence hypothesis rather than evidence the page is dead.
